descriptionChirho: A proper noun meaning 'the Rock has ransomed,' identifying the father of Gamaliel, leader of the tribe of Manasseh in the wilderness census (Num 1:10, 2:20, 7:54, 7:59, 10:23). The three sense clusters represent the full compound name and its two split halves ('Pedah-' and '-zur') that arose from tokenization artifacts. Spanish 'Pedasur,' Hindi 'पदासूर' (Padāsūr), Arabic 'فَدَاهْصُورَ' (Fadāhṣūra), Korean '브다술' (Beudasul), Swahili 'Pedasuri' — all transliterate the same individual consistently across six occurrences.
